parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: The personal access token. Not required if you authenticate with an Alibaba Cloud AccessKey pair or Security Token Service (STS).

parameters.name: localId
parameters.description: The local ID of the merge request, which is its number within the repository.

parameters.name: organizationId
parameters.description: The ID of the organization. You can find this ID in the URL of your organization page on Alibaba Cloud DevOps, for example: `https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/{organizationId}`.
